movie_title: Why do we procrastinate? ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: Why do people procrastinate? We’ll hear from a comedian who likes to leave their work until the last

vocabulary.definition: someone who keeps delaying things that need to be done
vocabulary.example: She's such a procrastinator that she never finishes her assignments on time.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of pleasure and satisfaction
vocabulary.example: He felt a sense of gratification after completing the difficult project.

vocabulary.definition: acting suddenly, without thinking about the consequences
vocabulary.example: Her impulsive decision to quit her job surprised everyone.
The garden offered a sense of serenity and tranquility.
The meeting was full of timewasters who kept veering off topic.

vocabulary.definition: to summarize or review the main points
vocabulary.example: Before the exam, she decided to recap all the key concepts from the textbook.
